questions.q: Section 66A of the IT Act was struck down as unconstitutional by the Supreme Court in

questions.q: Which statement about schedules is correct?

questions.q: Which organisation maintains the Red Data Book (Red List) of threatened species?
questions.exp: The International Union for Conservation of Nature maintains the IUCN Red List.

questions.q: A species found only in a particular geographical area and nowhere else is called
questions.exp: Endemic species are restricted to a specific region, e.g. lion-tailed macaque of the Western Ghats.

questions.q: The first species to colonise bare rock in primary succession are usually
questions.exp: Crustose lichens secrete acids that weather rock and start soil formation.

questions.q: A Class VI student writes 3/4 + 2/5 = 5/9. What misconception does this error most likely show, and what should the teacher infer?
options: The student adds numerators and denominators separately and does not grasp the need for a common denominator
The student has not memorised the multiplication tables
The student is careless and has no misconception
questions.exp: Adding top and bottom separately is a classic conceptual error; diagnosing it guides remedial teaching.

questions.q: The average age of 6 persons is 30 years. A new person joins and the average becomes 31 years. What is the age of the new person?
questions.exp: New total = 7 x 31 = 217; old total = 6 x 30 = 180; new person = 217 - 180 = 37.

questions.q: Three bells ring at intervals of 6, 8 and 12 minutes. If they ring together at 9:00 a.m., when will they next ring together?
questions.exp: LCM of 6, 8, 12 = 24 minutes, so the next common ring is at 9:24 a.m.

questions.q: A father is 3 times as old as his son. After 12 years he will be twice as old as his son. What is the son's present age?
questions.exp: Let son = x: 3x + 12 = 2(x + 12) gives x = 12.

questions.q: An exterior angle of a triangle is 110° and one of its interior opposite angles is 45°. What is the other interior opposite angle?
questions.exp: Exterior angle = sum of the two interior opposite angles, so the other = 110° - 45° = 65°.

questions.q: At what time between 5 o'clock and 6 o'clock do the hands of a clock coincide?
questions.exp: At 5:00 the hour hand is 150° ahead; the minute hand gains 5.5° per minute, so it takes 150 ÷ 5.5 = 27 3/11 minutes.

questions.q: Six friends P, Q, R, S, T, U sit in a row facing north. S is third from the left end, P sits immediately to the right of S, T is second from the right end and U is at the extreme right end. How many persons sit between S and U?
questions.exp: From the left: places 1, 2 are Q and R; S is 3rd, P is 4th, T is 5th, U is 6th. Between S and U are P and T.

questions.q: If a * b = 2a + b, then the value of (3 * 4) * 5 is:
In a class of 50 students, 30 play cricket, 25 play football and 10 play both. How many students play neither game?
questions.exp: Students playing at least one game = 30 + 25 − 10 = 45. Neither = 50 − 45 = 5.

questions.q:
Statements: Some birds can fly. Some birds are crows.
Conclusions: I. All crows can fly. II. Some crows can fly.
questions.exp: The birds that can fly and the birds that are crows may be entirely different groups, so neither a definite nor a partial link between crows and flying follows.
